result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but one clear data bug stands out: the Smash Bros Burgers card shows a '€NaN delivery' fee, which is a broken value. Other possible concerns, such as clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom, are intentional scroll affordances and were not counted.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, indicating a failed number calculation or missing data.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee calculation or data source so it returns a numeric value, and add a fallback such as 'Delivery fee unavailable' or hide the fee when it cannot be computed.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice, once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line, which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information in only one location on the card.
